lines.dialogue: Gloria, they're oh and six. Let's take it down a notch.
Honey, honey...
My daughter? to get up) No, that's funny, actually, no, she's my wife. Don't be fooled by the -- just give me a second here.
Gloria and I met the day my ex-wife moved to Florida. I was feeling pretty emotional and Gloria was one of the bikini bartenders at the giant pool party I threw.
Murders.
Jackass...
Not Manny, that Jabroney over there in the blue. He said something to me before I didn't appreciate.
It doesn't matter. Drop it.
And by the way, that little blow-up of yours with that other Mom -- why do you always have to do stuff like that? Could you try to remember this is Highland Estates, not Colombia?
I know, the whole hot Latin thing. I'm just saying, it's not a crime to leave some thoughts unexpressed.
No, not like -- well yeah, like me. Like a man. A man knows it's not appropriate to go around showing your emotion all the time.
Oh for Crissakes.
Hey, watch it.
Okay, not to be the evil stepdad here, but that's just not a good idea.

You do realize that's a suicide mission, right? He's 13, he's in a new school, and if he declares his love for a 16 year-old girl while wearing a puffy-sleeved white shirt we're going to be heading down to that school Monday morning with a bolt cutter to get him out of his locker. Oh geez, he's picking flowers.
Which were you doing? I'm hearing this for the first time.
I can't watch this.
No.
Of course it is.
I'll give him one thing, he's got some cahoneys.

a little) Okay, I think I got mad in the car because I was bugged about what that guy said to me at the game. He thought I was your Dad. And that's not the first time that's happened, people... thinking I'm too old for you.
And I guess I'm worried maybe you'll think that too some day.
Okay, that's enough of that.
Let's not go crazy. I'll be fine.

What?
I'll meet up with you guys.
Knock, knock!
No kissing! We're here.
Oh god. If Cam walks out here with boobs, I'm leaving.
What the hell's going on?
I gotta admit I never thought I'd get a baby out of you two. You're a cute little fortune cookie, aren't ya? Okay. That's wet. Someone take him.

What’s the key to being a great dad? Boy, that’s a tough one... CAMERON Giving them freedom to be whatever they want to be... CAMERON (CONT’D) Whether that’s a painter or a pilot or a president... CAMERON (CONT’D) Of a company or a country. MITCHELL Patience. PHIL Be their buddy. CLAIRE (O.S.) That’s your answer? PHIL And don’t do drugs. JAY Still thinking.

Yeah, like fog at an airport.
So the limo’s coming at four. This morning, I thought I’d go over to the club and hit a few balls.

Manny thinks his dad is Superman. The truth? He’s a total flake. In fact, the only way he’s like Superman is that they both landed in this country illegally. MITCHELL I don’t know why I’m so nervous. CAMERON They’ll love us. Let’s just be ourselves. MITCHELL Or, a slightly toned-down version of ourselves.
Hello. Oh. Hey Javier. Manny’s outside waiting for you. What? Why not?

His son’s sitting on the curb waiting to go to Disneyland and Superman can’t drag himself away from a craps table. And I’m the jerk. CAMERON So, seen any good movies lately? HELEN Well, my husband and I just rented Mamma Mia last night. I liked it, but I’m not sure Meryl Streep was the right choice. What did you think? CAMERON Excuse me, Meryl Streep could play Batman and be the right choice. She’s perfection. Whether she’s divorcing Kramer or wearing Prada and don’t get me started on Sophie. Oh my god, I’m tearing up just thinking about it. She couldn’t forgive herself. CAMERON

Okay, the key to being a good dad? JAY (V.O.) Look, sometimes things work out just the way you want... JAY (V.O.) And sometimes they don’t. You gotta hang in there. JAY (V.O.) Because when all is said and done, ninety percent of being a dad... is just showing up.

Where?
I’m pretty sure this is a typo.
Helicopter.
Wrestle. You wrestle -- you can’t box with alligators.
How would they get gloves on those little... claws?

No! Okay, now I forgot what we’re talking about. GLORIA I’m just saying that hobbies are important to the man, whether you’re risking your life or flying little planes from a safe distance. You’re here to “hang out?”
Do you have to just stand there? You’re making me uneasy.
For god’s sake, sit down. You can hold this wing in place while I fasten this.
Come on.
No.
Yeah, you would have been a great pilot.
If I wanted to.
No.
Tell you what. There’s another trick called “threading the needle.” I used to do it with Claire and Mitch when they were kids. You wanna try it?
You grab one of those hoops over there and go stand way, way, way at the end of the field, and I fly the plane through it.
No.
That’s good. Now stand still! Don’t move!
You must have moved. I told you to stay still.
Try not to talk. I want to make sure nothing’s broken.
Clear the way.
Just a little accident. Nothing big.
We were threading the needle and somebody moved.
That’s the painkiller talking, he’s a little loopy.
One of the wings is cracked and the propeller is bent, but I can --
Claire) Look, I didn’t ask for him to be there. He insisted. He took a chance and that’s what happened.
It was an accident.
I had just quit smoking --
You’re upsetting your husband.
It wasn’t my fault.
I know. I must be getting old.
I like Phil. It’s just that sometimes he tries too hard, you know? It’s kind of... irritating.
Maybe not in those exact words --
Whoa, whoa, when did we jump to love? And he’s not technically my son.
Sure I do. Believe me, while I was in the park, I really wished Manny was there.
It’s actually called an aileron. It controls the horizontal -- CLAIRE Yeah, that’s what’s important right now. Bye, Dad. JAY Hey, Phil.
I just want you to know, I’m sorry. It doesn’t matter if I missed, or if you moved --
Either way. I just want to say... I like you.
Yeah. PHIL What do you like about me? JAY Well... you’re a nice guy, you try real hard, you’re a good dad. PHIL I am a good dad. So are you. Come here.
Okie dokie...
Are you kidding me?
Come on, Cam. GLORIA Say it...
I like you too, Cam. PHIL What do you like about him?
Aw, jeez. Gloria, no...

Huh... great.
What?
He does a dance?
Hey, Sport, can I take a look at that whistle of yours?
Oh, darn it. Look at that.
Oh, jeez, what’s wrong with me?

I’m proud of our little Zorro! I mean I worked with him a little, but the kid’s got skills.
You know this nice moment I’m having with your son? You’re kind of wrecking it.
That’s my boy!
Incredible, isn’t it?

I know you’re not supposed to care, but it’s really cool knowing your kid’s the best at something, you know?
What she said! We better come back in the big car, we’re going to be bringing home some hardware.
Thank you all for coming down here and supporting the kid. You guys are the best!
Is everything okay?
So that wasn’t angry talk?
I’m beginning to understand why there’s so much conflict on your continent. Check it out.

Dude.

Who’s the baddest?

...winning feels pretty great. There’s nothing like having that moment in the sun.
